Game Overview

At its heart, Hunting Deer is a hunting game about step into the hooves of a deer fighting back against invading human birds in a whimsical battle of wits and reflexes. Master the art of precision shooting as you aim to take down unpredictable aerial intruders in a zany twist on traditional hunting challenges.
